meaning.en: To harbour secret, sinister intentions.
meaning.zh: 心里藏着不可告人的坏主意。

examples.zh: 他笑脸相迎，其实心怀鬼胎。
examples.en: He greeted us with a smile but was secretly scheming.

examples.zh: 大家都怀疑他心怀鬼胎。
examples.en: Everyone suspected him of having ulterior motives.

meaning.en: A primitive way of farming by clearing land with fire and sowing in the ashes.
meaning.zh: 古代原始的耕作方式：放火烧去草木，在灰烬上播种。

examples.zh: 山区的村民至今仍有刀耕火种的习惯。
examples.en: Villagers in the mountains still practise slash-and-burn.

examples.zh: 告别刀耕火种，当地农业走向机械化。
examples.en: Leaving slash-and-burn behind, local farming has become mechanised.

meaning.en: To have one's name recorded in history for posterity.
meaning.zh: 名字记载在史册上，流传后世。

examples.zh: 他为国捐躯，名垂青史。
examples.en: He gave his life for his country and is remembered in history.

examples.zh: 这些科学家的发现使他们名垂青史。
examples.en: Their discoveries earned these scientists a place in history.

pinyin: jǐng shuǐ bù fàn hé shuǐ
literal: well · water · not · intrude · river · water

meaning.en: Each minds their own business and does not interfere with the other.
meaning.zh: 彼此互不干涉，各管各的。

equivalents: keep out of each other's way

examples.zh: 我们俩井水不犯河水，各干各的。
examples.en: We keep out of each other's way and each do our own thing.

examples.zh: 两家公司业务不同，一向井水不犯河水。
examples.en: The two firms are in different lines and never interfere with each other.

usage.en: Often 一向/向来井水不犯河水.
usage.zh: 常说“向来井水不犯河水”。

meaning.en: To meet by chance as strangers, like duckweed drifting together on water.
meaning.zh: 像浮萍随水漂泊，偶然相遇，原本素不相识。

examples.zh: 我们只是萍水相逢，他却热心帮我。
examples.en: We had met only by chance, yet he helped me warmly.

examples.zh: 萍水相逢的旅伴，后来成了挚友。
examples.en: Travelling companions who met by chance became close friends.

story.en: Wang Bo: 'Duckweed meeting on the water: all of us are guests far from home' (萍水相逢，尽是他乡之客).
story.zh: 王勃《滕王阁序》：“萍水相逢，尽是他乡之客。”

meaning.en: The day one finally gets out of hardship and gains success.
meaning.zh: 摆脱困境、得到成功的那一天。

examples.zh: 总有一天，我们会有出头之日。
examples.en: Some day our day will come.

examples.zh: 他苦熬多年，终于盼到了出头之日。
examples.en: After years of struggle he finally saw his break.

usage.en: Often 有出头之日 / 没有出头之日.

natural: go through fire for a friend

meaning.en: To be willing to risk anything for a friend's sake.
meaning.zh: 为了朋友的义气，不惜付出巨大代价。

equivalents: go through fire and water for a friend
stand by a friend whatever happens

examples.zh: 为了朋友，他愿意两肋插刀。
examples.en: For his friends he would go through fire and water.

examples.zh: 真正的哥们儿，两肋插刀在所不辞。
examples.en: A true buddy would stop at nothing for you.

meaning.en: Beacon fires across the sky; a country ravaged by war.
meaning.zh: 战火遍地，形容战争激烈、局势动荡。

examples.zh: 那是一个烽火连天的年代。
examples.en: That was an age of raging war.

examples.zh: 烽火连天，百姓流离失所。
examples.en: With war raging everywhere, people were left homeless.

meaning.en: To have no descendants; also a harsh curse.
meaning.zh: 没有后代，也用作恶毒的咒骂。

examples.zh: 老人担心家族断子绝孙。
examples.en: The old man feared the family line would die out.

examples.zh: 骂人“断子绝孙”是很恶毒的话。
examples.en: To curse someone with 'may you have no descendants' is vicious.

usage.en: Literal, or used as a curse; avoid in polite speech.
usage.zh: 可指事实，又用于咒骂，不宜用于礼貌场合。

meaning.en: Neither arrogant nor impatient.
meaning.zh: 不骄傲，不急躁。

examples.zh: 取得好成绩后仍要不骄不躁。
examples.en: Stay modest and steady even after good results.

examples.zh: 他做事不骄不躁，稳扎稳打。
examples.en: He works without cockiness or haste, step by step.

meaning.en: To have done everything one could out of kindness and duty.
meaning.zh: 对人已尽了最大的善意和责任。

examples.zh: 我对你已经仁至义尽了。
examples.en: I've done everything I could for you.

examples.zh: 公司在补偿上做到了仁至义尽。
examples.en: The company was more than generous with compensation.

usage.en: Predicate; often 做到/已经仁至义尽.

story.en: Speaking of the year-end Zha sacrifice, the Record of Rites says it is 'the utmost of benevolence and the completion of righteousness' (仁之至，义之尽也). 仁至义尽 comes from it.
story.zh: 《礼记·郊特牲》论蜡祭：“蜡之祭也，仁之至，义之尽也。”后作“仁至义尽”。

meaning.en: Not worth mentioning, a polite way to wave off thanks.
meaning.zh: 不值得一提，常用作谦辞。

examples.zh: 这点小事不足挂齿。
examples.en: It's a small matter, hardly worth mentioning.

examples.zh: 举手之劳，不足挂齿。
examples.en: Just a small favour; don't mention it.

meaning.en: To write; sometimes to play with words or twist the law.
meaning.zh: 指写文章（含戏谑），也指玩弄文字技巧或曲解法律条文。

examples.zh: 他不爱舞文弄墨，更喜欢动手干活。
examples.en: He doesn't care for writing; he prefers doing things with his hands.

examples.zh: 他一辈子舞文弄墨，写了几十本书。
examples.en: He spent his life with pen in hand and wrote dozens of books.

meaning.en: Waves and clouds that change in strange ways; situations full of puzzling twists.
meaning.zh: 像水波云彩一样变幻莫测，形容局势或事物神秘多变。

examples.zh: 国际局势波谲云诡，难以预料。
examples.en: The international situation is shifting and hard to predict.

examples.zh: 这部小说情节波谲云诡，引人入胜。
examples.en: The novel's plot twists keep you gripped.

meaning.en: Great disaster is about to strike.
meaning.zh: 大的灾难就要降临。

examples.zh: 大难临头，他才想起去买保险。
examples.en: With disaster upon him, he finally thought of buying insurance.

examples.zh: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞。
examples.en: Husband and wife are birds in one forest, but each flies off when disaster strikes.

usage.en: Predicate; often 大难临头各自飞.

meaning.en: To loosen the hold deliberately in order to seize the target in the end.
meaning.zh: 想要捉住他，故意先放开他，使其放松警惕。

examples.zh: 警方对嫌疑人欲擒故纵，终于将团伙一网打尽。
examples.en: The police gave the suspect rope and finally netted the whole gang.

examples.zh: 他对客户欲擒故纵，反而谈成了价。
examples.en: By pretending not to care he got the client to agree on the price.

story.en: One of the Thirty-Six Stratagems: pressing an enemy too hard makes him fight back, so let him go to sap his will, then take him.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第十六计：“欲擒故纵。逼则反兵；走则减势。”

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

meaning.en: A tall, large horse.
meaning.zh: 又高又大的马。

examples.zh: 他骑着一匹高头大马进了城。
examples.en: He rode into town on a big, tall horse.

examples.zh: 仪仗队的高头大马整齐排列。
examples.en: The honour guard's tall horses stood in neat rows.

meaning.en: Small flaws do not obscure the jade's beauty; merits far outweigh faults.
meaning.zh: 小缺点掩盖不了大优点。

equivalents: a blemish doesn't spoil the whole

examples.zh: 这部电影有些小瑕疵，但瑕不掩瑜。
examples.en: The film has minor flaws, but its merits outweigh them.

examples.zh: 他虽有过失，瑕不掩瑜。
examples.en: He has made mistakes, but they cannot hide his virtues.

story.en: The Book of Rites on jade: 'Its flaws do not hide its lustre, nor its lustre its flaws' (瑕不掩瑜，瑜不掩瑕).
story.zh: 《礼记·聘义》：“瑕不掩瑜，瑜不掩瑕，忠也。”

meaning.en: A romantic affair or elegant love story; also gossip about one.
meaning.zh: 指男女之间的风雅韵事，也指风流艳事。

examples.zh: 文人的风流韵事常被后世传为佳话。
examples.en: Literati love affairs are often passed down as pleasant tales.

examples.zh: 八卦杂志专爱报道明星的风流韵事。
examples.en: Gossip magazines love to cover celebrities' romances.

usage.en: Noun phrase; tone ranges from elegant to gossipy.

meaning.en: Unrestrained and unwilling to be bound by convention.
meaning.zh: 行为放纵，不受约束。

examples.zh: 这位画家年轻时放荡不羁，常常通宵饮酒。
examples.en: The painter was bohemian in his youth, often drinking through the night.

examples.zh: 他放荡不羁的性格让父母担心。
examples.en: His wild, unbridled nature worried his parents.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can be critical or admiring.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，褒贬视语境。

meaning.en: To strike an attacker head-on with full force.
meaning.zh: 正面给敌人沉重的打击。

examples.zh: 我军对来犯之敌迎头痛击。
examples.en: Our army hit the invaders head-on.

examples.zh: 对造谣者要迎头痛击。
examples.en: Rumour-mongers must be answered with a hard blow.

meaning.en: A dead thing coming back in a new form; an old, discredited idea reappearing in disguise.
meaning.zh: 死者借他人尸体复活，比喻已灭亡的事物换个名目重新出现。

equivalents: a ghost returning in new form

examples.zh: 这种过时的制度又想借尸还魂。
examples.en: That outdated system is trying to rise again in disguise.

examples.zh: 老骗局借尸还魂，换了个新包装。
examples.en: The old scam is back from the dead, in new packaging.

origin.source: 《三十六计》第十四计；铁拐李传说

story.en: Stratagem 14 of the Thirty-Six: use what seems useless; the legend of Iron-Crutch Li, whose soul entered a beggar's body, popularised the phrase.
story.zh: 《三十六计》第十四计：“借尸还魂。有用者，不可借；不能用者，求借。”

date.zh: 明清之际 · 17世纪（成书年代不详）

meaning.en: When in dire straits, one thinks of changing the situation.
meaning.zh: 处境困窘就想改变现状。

equivalents: necessity is the mother of invention

examples.zh: 穷则思变，这个村子开始发展旅游。
examples.en: Driven by poverty, the village began to develop tourism.

examples.zh: 企业陷入困境，穷则思变，转型做电商。
examples.en: In trouble, the firm sought change and moved into e-commerce.

story.en: The Commentary on the Appended Phrases says 'when things reach their limit they change; changed, they go through; going through, they last' (穷则变，变则通，通则久). 穷则思变 is the popular form.
story.zh: 《周易·系辞下》：“《易》穷则变，变则通，通则久。”后作“穷则思变”。

meaning.en: Absolute power over life and death, reward and punishment.
meaning.zh: 掌握生死赏罚的大权。

equivalents: hold the power of life and death

examples.zh: 他掌握着员工的生杀予夺大权。
examples.en: He holds absolute power over his employees' fate.

examples.zh: 古代帝王握有生杀予夺的权力。
examples.en: Ancient emperors held the power of life and death.

usage.en: Often 生杀予夺之权/大权.
